description: Emails this YAFL share link to a recipient. The link carries the decryption key in its fragment – anyone with access to that inbox can open the file. Requires a verified account.

link.description: A YAFL share URL including the fragment key (e.g. https://yafl.dev/t/{id}#{key}), OR the compact {id}#{key} retrieval code printed alongside it — both resolve identically.

recipient.description: The email address to send the share link to.

name: email_link
title: Email a Share Link
